[**More of Your CompanyCam Data Is Now Open to the Tools You Already Use**](https://intercom.news/companycam/156729-more-of-your-companycam-data-is-now-open-to-the-tools-you-already-use#)

![Austyn avatar](https://static.intercomassets.com/avatars/5873887/original/Austyn_Avatar_2025_%282%29-1761924227.png)

Shared by Austyn
• September 08, 2026

If you connect CompanyCam to other software or use AI tools to automate parts of your business, this update is for you. Two changes landed this week that give you more direct access to your own data through the CompanyCam API and MCP integration, so you can build with it instead of just looking at it.

**Documents Can Now Be Created and Edited Through the API, Not Just Read**

Until now, the API and MCP integration could only pull existing Documents (formerly called Pages) out of CompanyCam. You could read them, but you couldn't build new ones or make changes through that connection. That's changed: you can now draft and edit Documents and reports directly through the API and MCP. If you run an integration or an AI tool that generates project reports, it can write a finished document straight into CompanyCam the moment a job wraps, using your latest photos, without anyone opening the app to build it by hand. This is available now to anyone using the CompanyCam API or MCP integration.

**Time Tracking Data Is Now Readable Through the API**

Clock-in and clock-out entries are now available to pull through the CompanyCam API, filterable by user, project, date range, or status. If you send CompanyCam data into payroll, project costing, or another back-office system, you can pull time data directly instead of exporting it by hand. The team is also building tools to pull pay-period totals and other summaries in one call, so anyone building payroll workflows won't need to add up individual entries one at a time. This is live now for anyone with API or MCP access.

[See the full list of tools](https://developers.companycam.com/)
